name: fpds-view-row
title: View row (unit)
description: The first row of every list page: which saved narrowing you are on (All or a view you made), a way to save the current one, and the list's own actions (Create, Export). It answers "which version of this list am I looking at, and how do I add to it or take it out?" — spec: docs/fpds/units/view-row.md:3. Needs fpds-theme.
